elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Thirty tabs open and you can't find the one you need?

[confident] Here's the fix. Search your tabs instead.

[friendly] Press Control, Shift and A. Type a word from the page title. Hit Enter and you're on that tab. On a Mac, it's Command, Shift, A.

[delighted] Any tab, found in about two seconds.
